criteria.description: Starts from the question/decision and data relationship (comparing retention curves over time across cohorts) before choosing a chart, rather than naming a chart by default.

Recommends an encoding that fits retention-over-time-across-cohorts (e.g. retention/line curves with weeks on X, or a cohort heatmap/triangle) and justifies it / rejects poor fits (e.g. pie, single bar).
Removes chart-junk and favors direct labeling / limited series, rather than a cluttered or legend-heavy chart (e.g. handling 6 overlapping lines legibly).
Addresses honest scales (e.g. consistent % axis) and accessibility (not color-alone for 6 cohorts), rather than ignoring them.
Frames an insight-led takeaway/title and what to highlight, not just 'retention by cohort'.
